reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.text: I have zero complaints about this app. I have used Buffro for a few months now and have never had any issues. This app is amazing and has so many workouts I can do and the routine feature is probably my favorite. The calorie tracker is very accurate and even if it isn’t the app allows you to edit it. Overall I love this app and don’t think I will ever use a different app.

reviews.title: Best fitness app ever
reviews.text: This app makes planning workouts way easier. The workout builder is really useful because you can put in your schedule, level, equipment, and what muscles you want to train, then it gives you a workout to follow instead of having to think of everything yourself. The routine builder is great too because it can plan the whole week and sync it with the calendar. Really helpful app, 10/10
